# Jeremiah 11 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** The-word which came to Jeremiah from-YHWH, saying:

**2** "Hear the-words-of this covenant, and-speak to-[the]-men-of Judah and-to-[the]-inhabitants-of Jerusalem.

**3** And-say to-them, 'Thus says YHWH God-of Israel: Cursed [is] the-man who does-not hear the-words-of this covenant,

**4** Which I-commanded your-fathers in-the-day I-brought-them-out from-[the]-land-of Egypt, from-[the]-furnace-of iron, saying, "Obey My-voice and-do them according-to-all which I-command-you, and-you-shall-be to-Me for-a-people, and-I will-be to-you for-God,"

**5** In-order-to-establish the-oath which I-swore to-your-fathers, to-give to-them a-land flowing [with] milk and-honey, as-this-day.'" And-I-answered and-said, "Amen, YHWH."

**6** And-YHWH said to-me, "Proclaim all these words in-[the]-cities-of Judah and-in-[the]-streets-of Jerusalem, saying, 'Hear the-words-of this covenant and-do-them.

**7** For earnestly-I-warned your-fathers in-the-day I-brought-them-up from-[the]-land-of Egypt until this-day, rising-early and-warning, saying, "Obey My-voice."

**8** But-they-did-not obey and-did-not incline their-ear, and-walked each in-the-stubbornness-of their-evil heart; and-I-brought upon-them all [the]-words-of this covenant which I-commanded to-do and-they-did-not-do.'"

**9** And-YHWH said to-me, "A-conspiracy is-found among-[the]-men-of Judah and-among-[the]-inhabitants-of Jerusalem.

**10** They-have-turned-back to the-iniquities-of their-first fathers who refused to-hear My-words, and-they went after other gods to-serve-them; the-house-of Israel and-the-house-of Judah have-broken My-covenant which I-made with their-fathers."

**11** Therefore, thus says YHWH: "Behold-Me bringing upon-them evil which they-will-not-be-able to-escape from-it; and-they-will-cry-out to-Me, but-I-will-not listen to-them.

**12** And-[the]-cities-of Judah and-[the]-inhabitants-of Jerusalem will-go and-cry-out to the-gods to-whom they burn-incense, but-they-will-certainly-not save them in-the-time-of their-evil.

**13** For [as the]-number-of your-cities were your-gods, Judah; and-[as the]-number-of [the]-streets-of Jerusalem you-set altars to-the-shame, altars to-burn-incense to-Baal.

**14** And-you, do-not-pray for this people, and-do-not-lift-up for-them a-cry or-a-prayer; for-I-am-not hearing in-the-time they-cry-out to-Me concerning their-evil.

**15** What [right] has-My-beloved in-My-house, [when] she-has-done [her] schemes [with] many? Can-the-holy flesh pass from-upon-you? When your-evil, then you-rejoice.

**16** A-green olive-tree, beautiful [with]-fruit [of]-form, YHWH called your-name; with-[the]-sound-of a-great tumult He-kindled fire upon-it, and-broken [are] its-branches.

**17** And-YHWH-of hosts, the-One-planting-you, has-spoken evil against-you, because-of the-evil-of the-house-of Israel and-the-house-of Judah which they-did to-themselves, to-provoke-Me by-burning-incense to-Baal."

**18** And-YHWH made-known-to-me and-I-knew; then You-showed-me their-deeds.

**19** And-I [was] like-a-gentle lamb led to-[the]-slaughter, and-I-did-not know that against-me they-devised schemes: "Let-us-destroy the-tree with-its-fruit, and-let-us-cut-him-off from-[the]-land-of [the]-living, and-his-name will-not-be-remembered again."

**20** But-YHWH-of hosts, judging righteously, testing [the]-kidneys and-[the]-heart, let-me-see Your-vengeance upon-them, for to-You I-have-revealed my-case.

**21** Therefore thus says YHWH concerning [the]-men-of Anathoth who-seek your-life, saying, "Do-not-prophesy in-the-name-of YHWH, and-you-will-not-die by-our-hand" —

**22** Therefore thus says YHWH-of hosts: "Behold-Me punishing-them; the-young-men will-die by-the-sword; their-sons and-their-daughters will-die by-famine.

**23** And-a-remnant will-not-be to-them, for I-will-bring evil upon the-men-of Anathoth — the-year-of their-punishment."

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **11:4**: Kur ha-barzel ('iron furnace') — Egypt as metalworking furnace, imagery of slavery as smelting process purifying Israel.

- **11:19**: Keves aluf — 'gentle lamb.' Jeremiah's self-description prefigures the Suffering Servant of Isaiah 53. The plot against him mirrors the covenant-breaking he preaches against.

- **11:20**: Bochen kelayot va-lev — 'testing kidneys and heart.' The kidneys (kelayot) were considered the seat of conscience in Hebrew anthropology.

— EMET
